protocol.purpose: Independent evidence-authored challenge pool; sample before running the unchanged chatbot. Gold reflects reviewed evidence, not parser support.
protocol.authorship_boundary: Only source bundle and project requirement/findings documents consulted; no chat-engine code, parser, tests, or model outputs inspected.
protocol.date_basis: Activity counts and year filtering use canonical activity report_date, not model-document denominators or inferred event dates.
protocol.claims_policy: Reported source assertions are not independent verification. Preserve strict/approximate bounds, populations, stages, attribution and overlap limits. Qualitative answer gold is binding through note, IDs, sources and required concepts even without a predefined plan kind.
protocol.context_policy: Supplied context is previous established programme/report-year scope. It is not part of the visitor question. Context aliases smedan/nigwed identify the named programmes.
protocol.selection: Main agent must seeded-sample 25 English and 25 Hausa before executing unchanged chatbot; retain seed, selected IDs and pre-run artifact hash.
protocol.release_gates: Research evaluation only; no public reveal, portrait clearance or Hausa human sign-off is implied.
